graph_requirements: shape-only Reshape, Squeeze, or Unsqueeze views surround provider-sensitive output paths
removing those views can change rank or layout decisions even when tensor values are unchanged

observation: Deleting shape-only singleton-tail operations reduced ONNX structure but materially regressed NPU latency.
mechanism: The views were effectively QNN layout metadata; removing them caused additional Transpose/layout work instead of removing device computation.

transformation.before: rank-preserving Reshape/Squeeze/Unsqueeze tail around provider-sensitive outputs
transformation.after: shorter ONNX tail with altered provider layout decisions

expected_evidence.trace: Negative case showed added Transpose/layout work and worse accelerator execution

outcome.latency: Material paired regression on QNN NPU
outcome.lesson: Fewer ONNX nodes did not mean less provider work

safety: Treat view removal as a provider-layout experiment
require matched trace and partition audit
reject added layout work unless end-to-end performance proves otherwise
counterexamples: Shape-only in ONNX does not imply cost-free or removable in provider lowering.
Static graph simplification is not a performance objective by itself.

provenance.scope_note: exact model, graph occurrence, toolchain, artifacts, and measurements remain run-local

discovery.lesson: Deleting shape-only views can reduce ONNX nodes while adding provider layout work and regressing latency.
